# Presentation Design / 簡報設計

- **id**: `presentation-design`
- **category**: Production / 產製

## What it does

**EN** — Turns an outline into slide-level layout decisions and hierarchy.

**繁中** — 把大綱轉成投影片層級的版面與資訊階層決策。

## Inputs

- outline from storytelling

## Quality bar

**EN** — One idea per slide; body text legible from the back row.

**繁中** — 一頁一個概念；最後一排看得清楚內文。
